name: Niagara Falls / Burlington
description: A Niagara–Lakeshore rail feeder developed from Burlington–Stoney Creek service, subsequently extended to Niagara Falls with express and short-turn variants.

timeline.event: Route 12 began between Burlington GO and Stoney Creek; Ontario later confirmed the June 2008 launch.
Year-round Niagara Falls–Burlington service began via St. Catharines, Grimsby and Stoney Creek.
The original table shows the full Niagara Falls VIA–Burlington route via Fairview Mall and Nash / Barton.
The timetable documents Friday express 12B toward Niagara Falls and 12D from St. Catharines toward Burlington.
The table serves Niagara College’s Niagara-on-the-Lake campus, Beamsville and Confederation GO; 12C trips were also increased.

sources.title: 50 Years of GO Transit Bus Operations — historical chronology by Adam Zhelka / Toronto Transportation Society
